blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Police have arrested a second principal suspect in the killing of 24-year-old Isaac Vergel Viernes, whose remains were found buried beneath cement in Barangay Pahina Central, Cebu City, after the suspect gave a videotaped extrajudicial confession detailing the alleged roles of three men in the killing, according to police.
